    @Extern(name = "malloc")
  fun malloc(size: ULong): Ptr<Unit>
    @Extern(name = "free")
  fun free(pointer: Ptr<Unit>)
    @Unsafe
  fun reconstruct<T : value>(raw: ULong): Ptr<T>
    =
      Call Ptr<T>
        Var raw
    @Unsafe
  fun forwardRaw<T : value>(raw: ULong): ULong
    =
      MethodCall toULong
        Call reconstruct<T>
          Var raw
  fun main()
    @Unsafe block
      val allocation
        Call malloc
          Call sizeOf<Int>
      val raw
        Call forwardRaw<Int>
          MethodCall toULong
            Var allocation
      val pointer
        Call Ptr<Int>
          Argument raw=
            Var raw
      MethodCall store
        Var pointer
        IntLiteral 42
      Call println
        MethodCall load
          Var pointer
      Call println
        MethodCall load
          Var pointer
          IntLiteral 0L
      Call println
        Binary Eq
          MethodCall toULong
            Var pointer
          Var raw
      val present: Ptr<Int>?
        Call Some
          Var pointer
      val absent: Ptr<Int>?
        Var None
      when
        Var present
        arm Some(value)
          Call println
            MethodCall load
              Var value
        arm None
          Call println
            IntLiteral 0
      when
        Var absent
        arm Some(value)
          Call println
            MethodCall load
              Var value
        arm None

            IntLiteral 43
      Call free
